content:
diego: Quick non-work update  two life things: I accepted the Head of Infra role today 389 and we adopted a rescue dog (meet Milo) this weekend 43649b. Figured Id share since youre my people.
samira: WHOA congrats on both!!! Head of Infra 389 and a pup?! pics pls 60d
noa: Huge congrats diego!! Milo is adorable 436436. Team celebratory walk + treats?
rick: Love this. Ill coordinate a quick office "pup-friendly" welcome next Friday at 4pm  20 mins, bring treats & dog cookies. Also I can swing by with a collapsible water bowl.
maya: :heart_eyes: could we do a tiny banner that says "Head of Infra & Head of Doggos"? also cake?
diego: Love all of it. Low-key please, no pressure on gifts. If folks want to chip in for a small welcome basket for Milo, I made a short sign-up (placeholder): https://tinyurl.com/milo-welcome
people-ops-bot: Congrats Diego! :tada: People Ops can reserve the commons for a 20-minute "Diego: Promo + Milo" drop-in and coordinate a group card. React with :handshake: if you'd like People Ops to manage coordination.
samira: :handshake:
noa: :thumbsup:
rick: Poll: Dog treats / Donut box / Mini cupcakes / Sparkling cider? React with emoji.
maya: :dog: (dog treats)
samira: :doughnut:
diego: :cupcake: honestly i will eat both
people-ops-bot: Reminder: follow Redwood gift policy. If you'd like People Ops to arrange a team gift, react with :handshake:.
diego: Thank you all  feeling lucky and excited (and sleep-deprived already from cuddles). Milo will be making a cameo at the drop-in if all goes well 43660a
